units.hotwater_kwh: kWh thermal energy per hourly interval

extract.changes: Select named columns and align to the supplied hourly grid. No filling or unit conversion.

usage_profiles.flat_screening: Exclude exact constant runs of at least 24 hours, identified within training only. Flags do not prove imputation.
usage_profiles.normalisation: Each building divided by its own maximum retained training electricity reading.
usage_profiles.group_mean: Equal-weight average of building mean profiles, computed in notebook.

selection.basis: Complete positive 2017 electricity and no long identical-value runs; selected before model comparison.

aggregation.units: kWh per one-hour interval; divide by 1 h for average kW
aggregation.selection: Margarito plus alphabetically first residence and office with complete 2017 training readings and no exact constant run >=24 h. Selection precedes aggregate/forecast comparison.
aggregation.clock: Same supplied Robin timestamps. No timezone conversion.
aggregation.membership: Fixed selected group; no documented shared feeder.
aggregation.changes: Select original cleaned source columns and complete training week. No filling, normalisation or zero substitution.
